description: This file provides a Flutter ChangeNotifier-based provider class 'RecipeProvider' that manages an in-memory list of recipes, allowing querying and filtering of recipes based on tags and search queries. It acts as a central state management component for recipes in a Flutter application.

classes.name: RecipeProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages a collection of Recipe objects, providing methods for retrieval, search, filtering, and tag-based queries.

methods.name: RecipeProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with an unmodifiable list of sample recipes.

methods.name: recipeById
methods.description: Returns a recipe by its ID from sample recipes mapping.

methods.name: allTags
methods.description: Collects all unique tags from recipes, normalized to lowercase and sorted.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches recipes matching the given query using the Recipe.matchesQuery method.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters recipes based on search query and/or required tags.

methods.name: byTag
methods.description: Returns recipes that contain a specific tag.
